title: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce - Business Studies - Transportation
exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: In commerce, the physical movement of people, raw materials, and finished goods from one location to another is defined as
questions.explain: **Transportation** is the aid to trade responsible for the physical carriage and movement of goods and persons from places of plenty (producers) to places of scarcity (consumers).
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A primary importance of transportation in commerce is that it creates
questions.explain: Transportation bridges the geographical gap by moving goods to where they are needed, thereby creating **place utility**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The type of transportation that offers the greatest flexibility by providing direct 'door-to-door' delivery services for goods is
questions.explain: A unique advantage of **road transport** (using cars, vans, and trucks) is its flexibility; it can pick up goods right at the factory door and deliver them straight to the consumer's doorstep.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A major disadvantage of road transportation is that it
options: is the slowest means of transport available
is easily affected by traffic congestion and bad weather
can only be used for international trade
does not require the payment of any maintenance fees
questions.explain: Road transport is highly susceptible to delays caused by **traffic congestion, bad roads, and adverse weather conditions**, making delivery times unpredictable.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which means of transportation is considered the fastest and most suitable for urgent, delicate, and perishable goods?
questions.explain: **Air transport** operates at very high speeds, making it ideal for urgently needed items (like medicines) and highly perishable goods, despite being the most expensive.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is a significant disadvantage of air transportation?
options: It has an extremely low freight cost.
It is suitable for transporting the heaviest machinery across oceans.
It is very expensive and has limited cargo carrying capacity.
It provides door-to-door services across cities.
questions.explain: Air transport's main drawbacks are its **high cost (expensive freight rates)** and strict limitations on the weight and volume of cargo it can carry compared to ships or trains.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: For the inland movement of extremely bulky and heavy goods such as coal, cement, and timber over long distances, the most suitable land transport is
questions.explain: **Rail transport** (trains) has a massive carrying capacity, making it the most cost-effective and suitable method for moving heavy, bulky goods over long distances on land.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The cheapest mode of transport for moving massive quantities of bulky goods (like crude oil exports and imported vehicles) internationally between continents is
questions.explain: **Water transport** (using cargo ships) is the cheapest and most common means of international trade for heavy, bulky goods, despite being very slow.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: What is the primary drawback of using water transportation for commerce?
options: It is extremely slow and unsuitable for perishable goods.
It cannot carry heavy or bulky goods.
It experiences constant traffic jams in the ocean.
questions.explain: The main disadvantage of sea transport is that it is **extremely slow**. A voyage can take weeks or months, making it totally unsuitable for urgent or highly perishable goods.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which specialized mode of transportation is designed almost exclusively for the continuous movement of liquids and gases such as water, natural gas, and crude oil?
questions.explain: **Pipeline transport** involves laying underground or surface pipes. It is a highly specialized, continuous, and secure method used specifically for liquids and gases.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies
